title: Examples / Video

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Distinguish a contributor’s affiliation from the video’s authorship so viewers understand who appears and who is speaking as a brand.
strategic_value: A partner-branded end card with limited IBM affiliation can acknowledge expertise without implying IBM produced the film.
demonstration: Two contributor-frame schematics compare IBM text and logo attribution; a separate end card shows only the partner logo.
practical_value: Choose text or logo for contributor affiliation, then retain the partner as the closing signature.

content_islands.name: Individual contributors
content_islands.spec: Stack two frames at left, pairing the person icon, name and role with either IBM text or a small 8-bar mark.

content_islands.name: End card
content_islands.spec: Place a large partner logo centered on the right-hand card.

content_islands.name: Example qualification
content_islands.spec: Retain the note that the illustrated options are not exclusive.

reference_purposes.Application: The page shows alternative IBM affiliation treatments for an individual and a partner-owned end card.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source explicitly treats the shown layouts as examples rather than the only allowed arrangements.
